name: Otokar Cobra / Cobra II
protection: Monocoque steel V-hull against small arms, fragments and mines. Game: immune to small-calibre (5.56/5.45/7.62x39/7.62x51); 7.62x54R AP and larger can penetrate side/rear and disable tyres/engine; every launcher in the game list penetrates.
visual_notes: Low wedge-nosed 4x4 with Humvee-derived running gear; Cobra II is larger and more upright with bigger windows
Small roof turret with gun shield; rear door
Azerbaijani Kobra-2 also used as ATGM carrier (Skif) and ambulance
variants: Cobra II pickup / Spike ATGM / mortar (ROU, licence-built at Medias)
